result.reason: The redline appropriately reduces the notice period to 30 days, satisfying the notice-window component of both the preferred and fallback positions. However, it includes neither the preferred 60-day Vendor renewal reminder nor any cap on renewal price increases. Because even the fallback requires price increases to be capped at 5%, the operative language does not fully reach the playbook position. The change is otherwise narrow and preserves the original renewal structure, though “thirty (30) days’ written notice” would be more professionally drafted.
